item.title: Who was in the picture Maxim Naumov held after his first Olympic skate?
item.description: USA’s Maxim Naumov holds a picture of his parents, who died in a plane crash last year, after competing in the figure skating men’s singles short program during the 2026 Milan Cortina Olympic Games at Milano Ice Skating Arena in Milan on Tuesday, Feb.10, 2026. Naumov’s parents Vadim Naumov and Evgenia Shishkova died after a mid-air collision of an American Airlines plane and an U.S. Army helicopter in Washington, D.C., on Jan. 29, 2025.
